implementation_changes.change: Add canonical JOB_TOOLS = ('list_files','read_file','search','write_file','run_command','fetch_source'). Extend each job keys(...) to include 'allowed_tools'. Validate: list, 0..6 unique strings, every name in JOB_TOOLS; if 'write_file' present then kind=='develop' and allowed_paths non-empty; if allowed_paths non-empty then 'write_file' in allowed_tools. Do not default missing allowed_tools. Migration: any plan/job lacking allowed_tools fails validate_plan (v1 and projected native).
implementation_changes.rationale: Makes per-job MCP surface a plan authority record, not prompt text. Compatibility: breaking for existing plans without the field—authors must declare exact subsets (typical develop: list_files/read_file/search/write_file/run_command[/fetch_source]; research/review/synthesis omit write_file and often run_command).

implementation_changes.change: Import or alias TOOL_NAMES from contracts.JOB_TOOLS. Broker.__init__(..., allowed_tools): store frozenset; require set(allowed_tools) <= set(TOOL_NAMES). definitions(allowed=None) returns only tools in allowed (default all only for unit helpers). serve_connection tools/list uses definitions(broker.allowed_tools). In call(), after name in TOOL_NAMES and request.json is written, if name not in allowed_tools: return receipted {'ok':False,'error':'tool not permitted for this job'} without setting uncertain; still charge max_calls. Never silently expand the allowlist.
implementation_changes.rationale: tools/list hides forbidden tools to cut wasted Devin calls; Broker.call remains fail-closed if the model still invokes them, with durable matched receipts so collect_filing does not treat policy denial as broker divergence/unknown. Compatibility: Broker constructor gains a required allowed_tools arg—all call sites must pass job allowlist; fixtures that omit it fail at construct.

implementation_changes.change: Pass packet['job']['allowed_tools'] into Broker(...). Keep NATIVE_DENY unchanged (no auth/config/autonomy edits). In collect_filing, after sorted(calls)==sorted(observed) and before filing parse: require every observed tool name ⊆ job['allowed_tools']; on violation raise CompletedFailure('provider completed; tool outside job allowlist'). Optionally append one prompt line that lists exact allowed tool names from the job (informational only; not authority). Do not weaken foreign-tool, model-identity, or receipt-divergence Refused paths.
implementation_changes.rationale: Closes the wave08 packet_violation path after transport/model/receipt qualification as CompletedFailure (same family as qualified_filing_fix), preserving unknown only for true provenance/cleanup uncertainty. Compatibility: jobs without allowlist never reach launch because plan validate fails first.

implementation_changes.change: Ensure native v2/v3 projection keeps job['allowed_tools'] when deep-copying into projected v1 before validate_plan; add an explicit require that every job has allowed_tools before projection so native errors name the field. No changes to pool/slots, credentials, cgroup cleanup, or report fail-closed artifact checks.
implementation_changes.rationale: Native admission continues to reuse validate_plan; projection must not drop the new field. Compatibility: same migration as contracts—update campaign plans; runtime behavior for already-valid plans with correct allowlists is unchanged aside from enforcement.

implementation_changes.change: Update Broker() helpers to pass an explicit allowed_tools (full set where tests need run_command). Add adversarial cases: (1) tools/list / definitions omit run_command when not allowed; (2) Broker.call('run_command',...) with allowlist excluding it → ok False, receipt charged, uncertain False, further allowed tools still work; (3) collect_filing export that includes mcp run_command while job.allowed_tools excludes it and broker has matching denied or successful receipt → CompletedFailure allowlist; (4) plan-shaped validate_plan rejects missing/duplicate/unknown tool names and write_file without develop+paths; (5) existing foreign/native/unreceipted/model/cleanup Refused cases remain Refused not CompletedFailure.
implementation_changes.rationale: Locks brief-cannot-substitute-allowlist and preserves fail-closed provenance semantics. Compatibility: test-only; production plans updated separately.

implementation_changes.change: Document required job.allowed_tools (subset of JOB_TOOLS), validation rules, enforcement points (validate, tools/list, Broker.call, collect_filing), and migration: old plans refuse until authors add explicit lists; briefs that say 'no run_command' are non-authoritative without omitting run_command from allowed_tools.
implementation_changes.rationale: Operator-facing contract for Devin-first waves. Compatibility: docs-only; no runtime effect.

design.summary: Require each job to declare an explicit allowed_tools subset of the six foundry MCP tools; enforce it at plan validation, MCP tools/list, Broker.call (receipted denial), and collect_filing so brief-only bans (wave08 budget run_command) cannot bypass. Migration: allowed_tools becomes a required job field (no implicit full set).
